Gifted: Blood.name: Gifted: Blood
Gifted: Blood.description:
🧬 Blood, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you work about a cupful at a time within a few meters: needles flicked from a nicked fingertip, a rope that hardens around someone's wrists.
📈 With training: sealed wounds, a marking drop you follow across the city, blood cables to swing on, a bullet-stopping shell, and spilled blood called back.
⚠️ Dried, soaked-in or washed-away blood slips out of your control.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as iron and fluids run low.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Vlad King (Blood Control), Stain (Bloodcurdle).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Blood.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Blood family): Scale: the user moves their own blood once it leaves the body through small cuts (lancet or existing wound). A new adult user works about a cupful at a time within about five meters and hardens it instantly; hardened blood holds until broken or released. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: dried, soaked-in or washed-away blood leaves their control; heavy blows break hardened blood. Never anyone else's blood; bound hands that cannot cut stop it. Quirk Strain: light: needles, cuff; moderate: wound seal, tracking drop, lifeline; heavy: shell over people, thorned lash; severe: signature, calling spilled blood back. Type: Emitter. Law: blood used on a person unlicensed is assault with a weapon; blood left at a scene is evidence police can match to the user.
